metaTitle: Custom Brown Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom brown badge ID holders in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for corporate security, events, and more.
introHtml: Brown badge ID holders offer a professional, understated look that blends seamlessly with earth-tone uniforms or security apparel. Unlike standard clear or black holders, brown variants help reduce visual clutter while keeping credentials visible. These holders work well for warehouse teams, outdoor event staff, or any organization that wants a cohesive, natural aesthetic. Consider imprinting your logo or department name on the holder itself for added brand consistency.
heroAltText: Custom brown badge ID holders with vertical orientation and clear vinyl window for displaying credentials
